## Pull request overview

Fixes build-breaking type mismatches between `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/spec` by aligning protocol enums, schema-derived input types (so `.default()` fields are optional at call sites), and emitted timestamp/stat field types.

**Changes:**
- Extended metadata loader protocol enums to include `memory:` and aligned metadata loader implementations to the colon-suffix convention.
- Switched `MetadataManagerConfig` / `MetadataLoaderContract` exported types to `z.input<>` so constructor/authoring inputs don’t require `.default()` fields.
- Standardized `timestamp` / `modifiedAt` outputs in `@objectstack/metadata` to ISO strings and updated tests/imports accordingly.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.zod.ts | Adds `memory:` protocol, introduces `watchOptions`, and changes config/contract exported types to `z.input<>`. |
| packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.test.ts | Updates protocol allow-list test to include `memory:`. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-loader.zod.ts | Adds `memory:` protocol and switches exported types to `z.input<>`. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-loader.test.ts | Updates protocol allow-list test to include `memory:`. |
| packages/metadata/src/node-metadata-manager.ts | Emits watch event `timestamp` as ISO string to match spec typing. |
| packages/metadata/src/metadata.test.ts | Updates mock protocols to `memory:`, fixes dynamic import extensions, and adjusts mock plugin context. |
| packages/metadata/src/loaders/remote-loader.ts | Aligns loader contract protocol to `http:`. |
| packages/metadata/src/loaders/memory-loader.ts | Aligns loader contract protocol to `memory:`. |
| packages/metadata/src/loaders/filesystem-loader.ts | Aligns loader contract protocol to `file:` and emits `modifiedAt` as ISO string. |
</details>

`watchOptions` in the system `MetadataManagerConfigSchema` doesn’t include the `ignoreInitial` flag that exists in the kernel schema. This keeps the two config schemas inconsistent and means `ignoreInitial` would be stripped if callers pass it through this schema. Consider adding `ignoreInitial: z.boolean().default(true)` here (or extracting a shared WatchOptions schema used by both system and kernel) to avoid drift.
```suggestion
    persistent: z.boolean().default(true).describe('Keep process running'),
    ignoreInitial: z
      .boolean()
      .default(true)
      .describe('Ignore add events for existing files on initial scan'),
```
